Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
[LSJ19970224] says:

"The Sabbat vampire targeted by a directed action doesn't get the +1
intercept bonus from Communal Haven: Temple."

Communal Haven: Temple's cardtext:

"Each Sabbat vampire you control gets +1 intercept when attempting to block
(D) actions directed against Sabbat vampires you control. A player may have
only one Communal Haven in play."

I have no idea what the ruling is based on, given the card text, which
seems pretty clear. If Kendrick is getting Sensory Deprived, he's (a) a Sabbat
vampire I control and (b) attempting to block a (D) action directed against
a Sabbat vampire I control.

What am I missing?

gomi

I have in front of me a Sabbat-printing Communal Haven: Temple and
a Sabbat War-printing Communal Haven: Temple. The only difference
in wording is that the Sabbat one says "A player may have only one
Communal Haven in play" and the SW one says "A Methuselah [...]".
